title: 第814章 自主护体熟人要来了第813章 毒药先行飞船上全员戒备
content_zh:
女帝反手拽住了他的袖子，力道不轻，令狐黎被拽得顿了一下。
“等等。”她的声音压低，目光扫了一眼走廊两侧，确认没有其他人在附近，“你这样直接去找船长，说‘我来帮你抓凶手’，你觉得船长会怎么想？
一个超神境中期的刀修，在这种跨大陆飞船上主动请缨，你觉得他是会感激你，还是会怀疑你就是下毒的人？”
“而且......”女帝松开手，“如果下毒的人还在这艘船上，你的修为暴露之后，他们会更谨慎，下一次动手会比这次更难察觉。
我们现在最该做的是保持现状，不要引起注意。”
令狐黎安静了一会儿，正要开口回答，一道破风声从走廊侧面的阴影中袭来。
那声音极短，从暗处射出，目标精准地指向女帝的后心。
声线非常细，轨迹笔直，直到逼近女帝背后三尺时才开始产生肉眼可辨的波动。
令狐黎还没来得及转身，女帝手指上的空间戒指亮了一下。
一道白光从戒指中射出，剑身浮现的瞬间已经完成了转向和定位。
天照剑从空间戒指中自主飞出，剑身横在女帝背后，剑尖与那道攻击的落点重合。
一声极短的金属撞击声在走廊中炸开，攻击被剑身弹开，在走廊墙壁上留下一道浅痕。
天照剑在完成格挡后悬浮在女帝身侧，剑尖指向攻击来源的方向，剑身的边缘呈现出一层自动展开后的灵力屏障状态，已经进入了警戒模式。
令狐黎的神识在同一瞬间向走廊两侧扫去。
覆盖范围内没有任何生命气息，没有躲藏的人，走廊另一端的拐角处也没有异常流动的阴影。
袭击者的撤退速度极快，在他神识扫过去之前就已经离开了攻击位置，在沿途并未留下任何可供追踪的痕迹。
走廊里恢复了安静，只有墙面上那道浅浅的白痕和被剑身弹开后落在不远处的黑色细针还留在原地。
细针通体漆黑，尖端残留着一层湿润痕迹，在灯光下隐约泛着不正常的暗色。
“哪里来的袭击？”女帝握住天照剑心有余悸地说道。
“速度快的连我都没反应过来......”令狐黎还在警惕地注意着周围。

“对方是个杀手。”炎君当即判断道。
很快，走廊远处传来一声短促的惊叫，随即是重物落地的声响，有什么东西从高处掉下来，砸在地板上发出一连串沉闷的碰撞声。
紧接着，另一个方向也传来了类似的响动。
有人喊了一声“什么人”，然后声音断了。
连接不同舱室的主要通道里陆续响起短暂的呼喊声、物体碰撞声和脚步声，从多个方向同时汇集到同一个中心。
走廊尽头传来船长通过船内广播系统发出的声音，覆盖了整个乘客舱段：“所有乘客立刻返回各自隔间，锁好舱门。
距离餐厅近的乘客前往餐厅集合，不要在走廊停留。
护卫队正在逐舱排查，请各位配合。”
令狐黎三人互相对视一眼，对方这是要劫机么？
content_en:
The empress grabbed his sleeve with her backhand, and the force was so strong that Linghu Li paused for a moment.
"Wait a minute." She lowered her voice and glanced at both sides of the corridor to make sure no one else was nearby. "If you go to the captain directly and say, 'I'll help you catch the murderer,' what do you think the captain will think?
A sword cultivator in the middle stage of the Super God Realm takes the initiative to volunteer on this kind of transcontinental spaceship. Do you think he will be grateful to you, or will he suspect that you are the one who poisoned him? "
"And..." The Empress let go of her hand, "If the person who poisoned you is still on this ship, after your cultivation is exposed, they will be more cautious, and the next time they attack will be harder to detect than this time.
The best thing we should do now is to maintain the status quo and not attract attention. "
Linghu Li was quiet for a while, and just as he was about to answer, a sound of breaking wind came from the shadows on the side of the corridor.
The sound was extremely short, shot from the darkness, and aimed accurately at the empress's back.
The sound line was very thin and the trajectory was straight. It did not start to produce fluctuations that were discernible to the naked eye until it was about three feet behind the empress.
Before Linghu Li could turn around, the space ring on the empress' finger lit up.
A ray of white light shot out from the ring, and the sword body had completed its rotation and positioning the moment it emerged.
The Amaterasu Sword flew out of the space ring on its own, with the sword lying across the empress' back, and the tip of the sword coincided with the landing point of the attack.
A very short metallic collision sound exploded in the corridor, and the attack was deflected by the sword, leaving a shallow mark on the corridor wall.
After completing the block, the Amaterasu sword floated beside the empress. The tip of the sword pointed in the direction of the source of the attack. The edge of the sword body showed an automatically deployed spiritual barrier, and it had entered alert mode.
Linghu Li's consciousness swept to both sides of the corridor at the same moment.
There was no life within the coverage area, no hiding people, and no unusually flowing shadows around the corner at the other end of the corridor.
The attacker's retreat was extremely fast, and he had already left the attack position before his consciousness swept over, leaving no traces for tracking along the way.
The corridor returned to silence, with only the shallow white mark on the wall and the thin black needle that fell not far away after being bounced off by the sword body still remaining in place.
The thin needle was completely black, with traces of moisture remaining on the tip, which glowed with an abnormal dark color under the light.
"Where did the attack come from?" the empress said with lingering fear while holding the Amaterasu sword.
"It was so fast that I didn't even react..." Linghu Li was still paying careful attention to his surroundings.
"The other party is a killer." Yan Jun judged immediately.
Soon, there was a short scream from the distance in the corridor, followed by the sound of heavy objects falling to the ground. Something fell from a height and hit the floor with a series of dull collisions.
Immediately afterwards, a similar noise came from the other direction.
Someone yelled "Who is it?" and then the voice broke.
Brief shouts, collisions of objects and footsteps sounded in the main passage connecting different cabins, converging from multiple directions to the same center at the same time.
The captain's voice came from the end of the corridor through the ship's public address system, covering the entire passenger cabin: "All passengers returned to their compartments immediately and locked the cabin doors.
Passengers who are close to the restaurant should go to the restaurant to assemble and do not stay in the corridor.
The escort team is conducting a cabin-by-cabin inspection. Please cooperate. "
Linghu and Li looked at each other. Is the other party planning to hijack the plane?
